trigger: R05-S3b validation window attempt1 invalid round after zero-mesh launch fix; local debug run shows cam1 depth mismatch

hfield_mesh.source: Rust build_hfield_mesh vs pinned upstream _optimize_hfield_mesh dump

reference_semantics.note: pinned env re-render reproduces fixture depth bitwise; reference is dist * -ray_dir_local_cam[2]

root_cause.mechanism: mujoco_warp math.quat_to_mat source formula is identical to src/math/mod.rs::quat_to_mat, but the GPU warp kernel is compiled with fuse_fp=true (--fmad=true) so products are fused; host Rust f32 does not contract. cam0 quat is exact identity (both arithmetics exact), cam1 quat from xyaxes is non-trivial -> 1-2 ULP matrix differences -> world ray 1-2 ULP -> hit t 1-7 ULP -> cam1 depth red.
root_cause.why_not_exposed_before: scene-a depth entities use reference camera_data pose bits (tests/support/render_bvh/s7b1.rs camera_data_poses, asserted bitwise); the quat path is only tolerance-checked (<=1e-6, tests/render_kernel_depth_seg.rs). The S3b hfield target is the first entity using CameraPose::from_fields with a bitwise depth criterion.

option_a_recommended.requires: Arch/Chief project registration before coding; exact fma order to be read from pinned warp cached PTX in target/render-bvh/r05-s3a-hfield-cache/1.15.0/wp_mujoco_warp._src.smooth_*

forty_pixel_closure.conclusion: the earlier 'dir bit-equal' subset was a host-side emulation artifact; with kernel-actual values the world dir differs on 99.6% of cam1 pixels (hit 6146/6150), origin equals everywhere, so all depth-mismatch pixels including these 34 are explained by the camera world pose ULP difference; no second phenomenon
